gate_ttl_note.source: n8n/wf_enrichment_cloud.json node 'Company Gate' — const REQUIRED / POLICY
gate_ttl_note.statement: Three of the four (Entain, Gravity Media, Ironman) have both required fields present with stamps well inside the 180-day TTL, so Company Gate emits action=skip and Decide Company Action never runs for them. That is the Phase 47.5 workstream-A defect, and it is why changing a region alone would not clear their flag today.

entain_second_veto.derived_from: fetched lv_produces_content and lv_anti_icp_reason on record 10024564084, this snapshot
entain_second_veto.lv_anti_icp_reason: Non-ANZ geography; No broadcast or streaming content
entain_second_veto.statement: Entain's reason string already carries TWO vetoes. lv_produces_content reads false, which fires the no-content hard veto independently of geography. A region flip therefore cannot move Entain off Tier D. It is out of the write set on the data, not on an assumption.

region_property_live.name: lv_country_region_normalized
region_property_live.comment: The LIVE option set is wider than D-V5's allowed set (AU/NZ/ANZ/Other/Unknown) — the portal also accepts US, UK and EU. Any value plan 06 writes must come from this live list. Under D-V6's semantics only AU, NZ, ANZ and Unknown are non-veto; US, UK, EU and Other all collapse to non_anz in the scoring engine. Recording the divergence, not acting on it — normalizing the option set is Phase 48 D-V5 work, out of scope here.
